entries.name: Daniel Hamm

expected.charges: First-degree murder of Margit Sugar (April 29, 1964 Harlem clothing-store killing).

updates.sentence: Originally sentenced to life imprisonment. Resentenced on May 11, 1971: 10-20 years for first-degree manslaughter, consecutive to 5-15 years for first-degree attempted murder; a 5-15-year attempted-robbery term ran concurrently with the attempted-murder term. Combined sentence: 15-35 years. A planned December 14, 1972 parole release was rescinded before release. Released on parole in 1974; the exact release date remains unverified.

entries.rationale: Appellate opinion supplies the subsequent sentence and distinguishes cancelled proposed parole from actual release. Preserve original sentencing date and release-year precision; do not infer exact custody endpoints.
